source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.
raw:
{
  "literal": "الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء.",
  "adaptation": "الجمعة البيضاء: خصم بيوصل لـ 70% على كل حاجة.",
  "back_translation": "White Friday: discounts reaching up to 70% on everything.",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' (الجمعة البيضاء) because Friday is a blessed day in Islamic culture and associating it with 'black' has negative connotations, while using natural Egyptian vernacular for the offer."
}

notes: Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' (الجمعة البيضاء) because Friday is a blessed day in Islamic culture and associating it with 'black' has negative connotations, while using natural Egyptian vernacular for the offer.
